title: Divide Array Into Equal Pairs
description: An array can be divided into pairs when every element belongs to exactly one pair of equal values. Given an even-length array `nums`, return whether such a division is possible. Input: `nums`. Output: true if every value has even frequency.
hints: Sort or count values once, then process each candidate in a single pass.
Check duplicates, all-equal inputs, and boundary values for `k`.
